title: Limiting weight bounded by finite majority weight
statement: Let $n$ and $j$ be natural numbers, with $n$ odd and $j\le n$. The limiting majority Fourier weight at level $j$ is at most the total Fourier weight at level $j$ of the majority function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube.
